propositions.name: aether_exists_and_mediates_forces
propositions.statement: Matter moves through the aether, and the aether mediates the interaction of electric and magnetic forces, an interaction to which intermolecular forces are analogous.
propositions.quote: considerations in regard to intermolecular forces analogous to the interaction, through the mediation of the æther, of electric and magnetic forces

propositions.name: contraction_hypothesis_explains_michelson_morley
propositions.statement: The contraction hypothesis explains the negative results of the Michelson-Morley experiment of interference between two rays, at right angles and parallel to the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: explain the negative results of the Michelson-Morley experiment of interference between two rays, at right angles and parallel to the earth's motion

propositions.name: index_excess_proportional_to_density
propositions.statement: The excess of the index above unity is assumed to be proportional to the density.

propositions.name: strain_produces_double_refraction_in_glass
propositions.statement: Double refraction can be produced in glass by a given strain, so the assumption that the excess of the index above unity is proportional to density does not seem entirely valid for glass.
propositions.quote: The second assumption does not seem to be entirely valid for glass, at least, when compared with the double refraction produced by a given strain

propositions.name: correction_reduces_margin
propositions.statement: Correcting the first assumption reduces the margin for the contraction hypothesis to 50 times for a liquid and 1.5 times for glass.
propositions.quote: The first correction reduces his margin down to 50 times for a liquid and 1.5 times for glass

propositions.name: rayleigh_method_not_conclusive_but_only_one
propositions.statement: The method used to test the contraction hypothesis by double refraction is not a conclusive test but is the only experimental one attempted.
propositions.quote: the method of Rayleigh cannot be regarded by any means as a conclusive test of the hypothesis, it is the only experimental one attempted

propositions.name: earth_has_orbital_motion
propositions.statement: The earth has an orbital motion, and the plane of polarization can be shifted relative to the direction of that orbital motion.
propositions.quote: the other a similar system rotating about a horizontal axis so as to shift the plane of polarization from a position at 45° to the earth's orbital motion through an angle of 90°

propositions.statement: A lens converges the sun's rays, and mirrors reflect the rays, which then pass through a nicol.

propositions.statement: There is no double refraction in the water due to its motion through the aether, to the order of sensibility attained.
propositions.quote: we may conclude that to this order of sensibility there is no double refraction in the water due to its motion through the æther

propositions.name: earths_field_of_force_rotates_polarization
propositions.statement: A rotation of the plane of polarization due to the earth's field of force would not affect the match.

propositions.name: magnetic_rotation_direction_independent
propositions.statement: The rotation due to a magnetic field is always in a definite direction and independent of the direction of the ray.
propositions.quote: the rotation due to a magnetic field is always in a definite direction and independent of the direction of the ray

propositions.name: verdet_constant_and_earths_field_value
propositions.statement: Verdet's constant for water is 0.015 and the earth's field is 0.2, giving a rotation for a length of 30 metres.

propositions.name: mascart_index_density_water_compression
propositions.statement: Under compression of water, the increment in the excess of the index above unity is nearly proportional to the increment of its density.
propositions.quote: Mascart has shown that in the case of water under compression the increment in the excess of the index above unity is nearly proportional to the increment of its density

propositions.name: motion_through_aether_could_change_density_and_frequency
propositions.statement: Movement of matter through the aether could produce an increase in density, producing a change in the natural frequency of the molecular systems, similar to what occurs in glass.

propositions.name: double_refraction_is_velocity_difference_between_components
propositions.statement: Double refraction is the greatest difference in velocity or in index between two components of light in a medium.

propositions.name: light_has_wavelength

propositions.name: compression_of_glass_shows_double_refraction

propositions.name: magnetic_field_produces_double_refraction_in_glass
